id: \rJessie: Hahaha! You foolishly got on our stolen blimp.
en: \rJessie: Hahaha! You foolishly got on our stolen blimp.

id: \bJames: There's no where to run now, twerp.
en: \bJames: There's no where to run now, twerp.
it: \bJames: Ora non hai più vie di fuga, moccioso.

id: \bMeowth: So it would be best to just hand em over.
en: \bMeowth: So it would be best to just hand em over.
it: \bMeowth: Quindi ti conviene consegnarceli e basta.

id: \bMeowth: Wait! Who is driving this thing?
en: \bMeowth: Wait! Who is driving this thing?
it: \bMeowth: Aspettate! Chi sta guidando questo coso?

id: You managed to survive the crash.
en: You managed to survive the crash.
it: Sei riuscito a sopravvivere allo schianto.
